label: The existing two-object identity-parthood interpretation…, by Typed-well-founded-mereologic…
meaning: Import the exact previous consistency theorem on its two identity-parthood atoms. Let Prior equal the sole origin→effect edge. Strict parthood is empty, so proper-part well-foundedness, P6 and proper-part priority are vacuous; cause-to-effect-part priority and the outgoing edge are nonvacuous. Transitivity is vacuous, priority is irreflexive, and explicit N=origin/M=effect witnesses the endpoint. This is a formal interpretation, not physical realizability.
